name: Aoe Kuon
source:
Taichi's classmate, a half between a vampire and a yuki-onna.

Due to her sheltered upbringing, Kuon isn't very wary of boys nor has any prejudice against them. She accidentally kissed Taichi and spilled some blood in that moment, which was drank by him and awakened him to "Awakening Essence". In order to receive it inside her body, she is told by her mother to have sex with Taichi.
